'''House Halliikeenovich'''<ref name="TEA" /> was a lesser<ref name="SWC:TP" /> noble house, one of the [[Ancient Houses]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]'s [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region. The house's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was the crowded urban [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dramassia]], located within the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], known for its exports of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment and exceptionally soft [[Dramassian shimmersilk]]. The originators of the family were wealthy [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlders]] who followed the entrepeneur [[Thull Vandron]] to settle the Senex-Juvex region around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], following Vandron's disillusionment with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s direction after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]]. While Dramassia was an economic powerhouse in its [[Sector/Legends|sector]] thanks to its exports, other houses in the Senex-Juvex thought of its power as vaguely unseemly. House Halliikeenovich was perceived as greedy and grasping, with individuals from the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> planets<ref name="Neelanon CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|367|Neelanon}}</ref> [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]] and [[Neelanon/Legends|Neelanon]] dismissively referring to members of the family as "peddler [[Prince/Legends|princes]]."<ref name="TEA" />

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Són Halliikeenovich]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the House, was courting [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]],<ref name="SWC:TP" /> a scion of [[House Taneel]] of Neelanon, who represented the Senex sector in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="CSWE Taneel">{{CSWECite|III|216|Taneel, Terr}}</ref> Halliikeenovich hoped to strengthen both their houses<ref name="SWC:TP" /> and establish a stronger connection between House Halliikeenovich and the houses of the Senex sector.<ref name="CSWE Halliikeenovich">{{CSWECite|II|10|Halliikeenovich, Són}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
House Halliikeenovich, via Són Halliikeenovich, first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Halliikeenovich was identified as a member of a noble house in ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'',<ref name="SWC:TP" /> released on [[October 27]], [[2005]]<ref name="Chronicles date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20050817.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels''}}</ref> but the noble house's name, House Halliikeenovich, was not identified until the release of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="TEA" /> on [[August 18]], [[2009]].<ref name="TEA date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> In that reference book, House Halliikeenovich is misspelled as "House Hallikeenovich" on page 210, but the spelling matches Són Halliikeenovich's name on page 214.<ref name="TEA" />
